column1: # form-fill.tsv: proposed values for empty inflection cells (plan subphase 6.3). Review artifact only; nothing here is written into the vocabulary TSVs until the 2.7 approval and 6.4.

# Source: kaikki.org Wiktionary extract of the English Wiktionary Russian entries (wiktextract), extracted 2026-10-30 from the enwiktionary dump dated 2026-10-01: https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Russian/index.html. Cross-check: OpenRussian (github.com/Badestrand/russian-dictionary, CC BY-SA 4.0), shown in the reference column.

# Licence: Wiktionary entry text is dual-licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (CC-BY-SA) and the GNU Free Documentation License (GFDL) (en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights). kaikki.org states no licence text, only a citation request (Tatu Ylonen, Wiktextract, LREC 2022) and a request to link to kaikki.org. Values derived here are CC BY-SA from en.wiktionary; the entry URL in each row is the attribution.

# Candidate cells: empty ("") in both the TSV and the live Anki collection. Explicit dashes and hand-edited cells are never candidates. Stress is U+0301, absent on monosyllables and on ё, matching the house format.
# Excluded cells (plan list (case-text-routing.tsv not yet committed)): Adverbs Formation, Numerals Gender Forms, Numerals Genitive, Pronouns Oblique Forms.
# Rows: 2355 total = 2267 missing-filled + 88 unresolved + 0 not-applicable. Unresolved rows have an empty value and an empty reference: hand-cite them, nothing is guessed.

# Coverage by field (filled/candidates): Nouns Genitive Sg 613/617; Nouns Genitive Pl 596/619; Verbs Conjugation 160/160; Verbs я (1sg) 160/160; Verbs ты (2sg) 160/160; Verbs они (3pl) 160/160; Verbs Past (m / f) 175/175; Adjectives Short Form 130/149; Adjectives Comparative 113/154; Adverbs Comparative 0/1.

# Oracle (already-filled cells, generator vs house value; exact / spelling-only / differs / no-output): Nouns Plural 490/1/6/0; Nouns Genitive Sg 9/0/0/0; Nouns Genitive Pl 5/2/1/0; Verbs Conjugation 36/0/14/4; Verbs я (1sg) 50/0/2/0; Verbs ты (2sg) 50/0/2/0; Verbs они (3pl) 50/0/2/0; Verbs Past (m / f) 32/0/5/0; Adjectives Short Form 8/2/3/1; Adjectives Comparative 3/2/0/2; Adverbs Comparative 60/1/0/26. Disagreements are mostly hand-edited house cells (free-text Conjugation, perfective-future forms, variants); filling never overwrites them.

# Wiktionary footnote marks (* and ^*) were removed from: брат Genitive Pl, воздух Genitive Pl, мечта Genitive Pl, молоко Genitive Pl, мясо Genitive Pl, носок Genitive Pl, носок Genitive Sg, плечо Genitive Sg.

# Review notes: Verbs Conjugation is emitted only when the 2sg/3pl endings agree (1st -ешь/-ут, 2nd -ишь/-ат); irregular or mixed verbs are unresolved. Adverb and adjective comparatives drop the (по) prefix. Adjective short forms list m, f, n, pl as Wiktionary gives them; the OpenRussian note flags where its stress or forms differ.
